slides.headline: 205 unicorns overseas have an Indian-origin founder. Together, they're worth $560 billion.
Prosus and Dealroom released the Indian Diaspora Index in September 2026
slides.body: The index tracks 205 current and former unicorns outside India with at least one founder who grew up in India - attributing $560 billion of founder-share value to them. Of those 205 companies, 91% are based in the United States.

slides.headline: Diaspora founders alone are worth more than India's own unicorn ecosystem.
slides.body: 70 of those overseas unicorns were built entirely by all-Indian founding teams, worth $243 billion combined - names like Jay Chaudhry (Zscaler), and the founding teams behind Rubrik and Nutanix. For comparison, India's own 102 home-grown unicorns - led by Flipkart, Zomato and Groww - are worth roughly $349 billion on the same basis.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: The talent never left India. It just built somewhere else first.
slides.body: A Viksit Bharat by 2047 doesn't need every builder to stay home - it needs the value they create abroad to keep flowing back through investment, mentorship and eventually, homecoming. $560 billion is proof of exactly how much capacity is out there to draw on.
